title: Peer valuation multiple bridge
prompt:
Prepare the valuation bridge explaining Alder Ridge's indicated discount to the approved public-company peer group.

Use the Q2 board, lender, and investor-relations correspondence and the source-tie follow-up, together with the July 3 controller-reviewed peer support, current market-data pull, comparability decisions, and approved valuation methodology. Treat the June 27 banker pull as comparison history only. Tie Alder Ridge's posted LTM adjusted EBITDA through the contractor-accounting records, while keeping the peer multiples and valuation adjustments tied to the controlling market sources.

Using the six approved peers at the common measurement date, calculate the median EV / LTM adjusted EBITDA multiple and Alder Ridge's observed discount to that median. Starting from the peer median, apply the signed growth, margin, recurring-revenue, leverage, and size adjustments exactly once to derive the supported multiple. Do not add an unsupported control premium. Apply the supported multiple to posted LTM adjusted EBITDA, subtract net debt, and divide by diluted shares to derive the implied enterprise value, equity value, and value per share.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `alder_ridge_ev_ebitda`, `peer_median_ev_ebitda`, `observed_multiple_discount`, `growth_adjustment`, `margin_adjustment`, `recurring_revenue_adjustment`, `leverage_adjustment`, `size_adjustment`, `supported_ev_ebitda`, `implied_enterprise_value`, `implied_equity_value`, `implied_value_per_share`. Use dollar values to two decimals and multiples to at least four decimals.
